title: Game crashes with signal 11
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in v4.7.1.stable.mono.official [a13da4feb] and v4.7.2.stable.mono.official [ed1daf0bf]

### System information

Godot v4.7.1.stable.mono - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.31041.1004) - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 31.11 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

I ran into this crash today. As per recommendation, I built Godot with debug symbols and ran it, so here is the log:

### Steps to reproduce

To reproduce the issue easily, you require to run my game and load a save file. Save file must be placed into "saves" directory inside "Settlers" directory in the App data. The game will crash after a few minutes. You can speed it up with a slider in the bottom.

[2026-10-17 15-54-23.json](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33598231/2026-10-17.15-54-23.json)
